s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal mass with chronic vomiting and right upper-quadrant pain
salient_findings: Large, firm, palpable mass in the right upper quadrant
Large retroperitoneal mass with fatty and soft-tissue components
key_facts: 2-year history of intermittent vomiting
Right upper-quadrant pain
Sensation of fullness on the right side of the abdomen
Denies urinary symptoms or changes in bowel habits
History of heavy menstruation and iron deficiency anemia
Oral iron therapy for over 10 years
Beta-thalassemia trait on hemoglobin electrophoresis
Hemoglobin levels ranging from 6 to 10 g/dL
Abdominal ultrasonography showed a well-defined hyperechoic heterogeneous mass
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion
MRI confirmed a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass

differentials: Paraganglioma of the organ of Zuckerkandl
Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor with rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation
per_call: Paraganglioma of the organ of Zuckerkandl
Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor with rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation

shortlist.label: Myelolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large, well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion with mostly fat density and internal areas of soft-tissue density on imaging

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous mass with areas of fat and soft tissue density on imaging, consistent with liposarcoma

shortlist.label: Adrenal myelolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Location in the hepatorenal space and composition of the mass are consistent with adrenal myelolipoma

shortlist.label: Retroperitoneal teratoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large, complex mass in the retroperitoneum with heterogeneous components on imaging

shortlist.label: Retroperitoneal lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large, well-defined, predominantly fatty mass in the retroperitoneum on MRI

raw.rationale: The mass is located in the right adrenal gland area and has a predominantly fatty composition with soft-tissue nodular areas, consistent with an adrenal myelolipoma.

rejected.label: Myelolipoma
rejected.why: Too general, as the location is specific to the adrenal gland

rejected.label: Liposarcoma
rejected.why: Malignant tumor, but the imaging shows a well-defined, encapsulated mass without invasion

rejected.label: Retroperitoneal teratoma
rejected.why: Typically contains multiple tissue types, but the mass is predominantly fatty

rejected.label: Retroperitoneal lipoma
rejected.why: Does not account for the soft-tissue nodular areas and the specific location in the adrenal gland area
